description: This Java source file defines the CategoryControlServlet class, which extends the ControlServlet class. It acts as a master servlet managing the default page, page not found page, and control servlet configuration for the web application related to product categories in the OFBiz framework. The class initializes servlet parameters from the servlet context and provides getter and setter methods for configuration properties.
